_comment: Copy to config.json (the installer does this) and fill in. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

simulator._comment: Empty udid = use the one booted simulator. Pin it when several are booted.

chat._comment: Optional hints. Without them the lowest text input is the composer and the button right of it is Send.

endpoints._comment: Local HTTP endpoints the agent may GET for evidence. {placeholders} are filled from fetch(vars=...).

logs._comment: Log files the agent may read, e.g. a bot started with: <start command> 2>&1 | tee ~/chat-logs/bot.log
